title.rendered: Standing Declarations of a Believer: Hold Fast the Confession | How to Declare Like Jesus Did, Day 14

excerpt.rendered: Hebrews 10:23 commands us to hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering. Day 14 closes the series with a set of standing declarations every believer can carry for life.

content.rendered:
A declaration is for a moment. A standing declaration is for a lifetime. On the last day of the series, we close with a set of confessions every believer can carry into the rest of their life.

The Gospel For Today | Saturday, October 31, 2026 | How to Declare Like Jesus Did, Day 14

Today’s Scripture

“Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.”
Hebrews 10:23 (NKJV)

“For assuredly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be removed and be cast into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that those things he says will be done, he will have whatever he says.”
Mark 11:23 (NKJV)

Today’s Message

Over fourteen mornings, from Lagos to London, Manila to Nairobi, São Paulo and far beyond, we have been retraining our mouths. We laid the foundation. We prophesied to the dry bones. We faced down the power of the tongue. We learned to call things that are not as though they were. We walked in the spirit of faith. We settled who we are in Christ. We declared over our body, our mind, our household, our provision, and our work. We spoke the enemy down, and we found the rhythm of morning and night. Today, we hold the whole thing fast.

Hebrews 10:23, in the NKJV, says, “Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.” The AMPC says, “Let us seize and hold fast and retain without wavering the hope we cherish and confess and our acknowledgment of it, for He who promised is reliable (sure) and faithful to His word.” The TPT says, “So now we must cling tightly to the hope that lives within us, knowing that God always keeps his promises.” Mark 11:23 anchors it with Jesus’ own guarantee that whoever says and does not doubt will have what they say.

So we end this series with a set of standing declarations. Not for this week. For the rest of your life. Save this page. Print it. Pin it. Put it in your voice-note library. Read it in the car. Read it before preaching. Read it over your children before school. Read it over your spouse at bedtime. These are the confessions of a believer who has learned the Jesus-pattern of declaration.

And remember Pray As You Go: these declarations are not meant to replace prayer; they rise out of prayer. Pray, then declare. Breathe, then speak. Live, every day, as a child of God whose mouth agrees with heaven. “He who promised is faithful.”

The Pattern of Declaration: One Last Time

Acknowledge. God has already said who you are, what He has done, and what He will do. Find it in Scripture.

Personalise. Write your name into the eternal promises. The gospel is not written for a crowd; it is written for you.

Proclaim. Speak it, calmly and consistently, as a lifestyle, not as a performance.

Standing Declarations of a Believer

I declare and acknowledge that I am a child of God, loved before I was born, chosen before the foundation of the world, washed in the blood of Jesus, filled with the Holy Spirit, and sealed for the day of redemption.

I declare that I am a new creation; the old is gone, the new has come. I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. I am seated with Christ in heavenly places, far above every principality, power, might, and dominion.

I declare that by the stripes of Jesus I am healed. My body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, and the Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives in me. Every system of my body aligns with the design of the Creator and the finished work of the Redeemer.

I declare that I have the mind of Christ. My thoughts are renewed by the Word. The peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, guards my heart and my mind. Anxiety has no landing strip; confusion has no voice; fear has no seat at my table.

I declare that as for me and my house, we serve the Lord. My spouse, my children, my parents, my siblings, my household, we are the Lord’s. The promise is to me and to my children.

I declare that my God shall supply all my need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus. He gives me power to get wealth, that He may establish His covenant. The blessing of the Lord makes rich, and He adds no sorrow with it.

I declare that the beauty of the Lord my God rests upon the work of my hands. He establishes the work of my hands; yes, He establishes the work of my hands. I am blessed in the city and blessed in the country, blessed in my coming in and blessed in my going out.

I declare that I am submitted to God and the devil flees from me. I trample on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy. No weapon formed against me shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against me in judgment I condemn.

I declare that the mercies of God are new over me every morning, and His faithfulness covers me every night. Great is His faithfulness. I hold fast the confession of my hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful. In Jesus’ name. Amen.
